economy.title: Budget & offers
economy.description: Weekly budget, planning style and supermarket offers. Online offers use the unofficial marktguru.de interface (leaflets of Aldi, Lidl, REWE, EDEKA, Penny, Netto, Kaufland …); it can change at any time – for private use only. With online offers the shopping list field 'Artikel hinzufügen' also searches marktguru live (what you type, from 3 characters, with the postcode of your branch).

data_description.weekly_budget: EUR per week for food, 0 = no budget.
data_description.plan_strategy: Used for automatic planning and suggestions.
data_description.offers_source: Where current and upcoming offers come from. marktguru: daily search for the postcodes of your branches, plus a live search while you type in 'Artikel hinzufügen'.
data_description.zip_code: For the offers of the shops near you. Can stay empty if your branches (in the panel) have a postcode – then their postcodes are searched.
data_description.offer_stores: Only offers of these shops (without branches). With branches their stores count.
data_description.offers_watchlist: Additional products to look for, comma separated (e.g. 'Kaffee, Butter').

stores.title: Stores & shopping
stores.description:
How the shopping list is split across your stores, where branches are searched and whether REWE online prices are loaded. You choose your branches in the Essensplaner panel under '🏪 Läden & Preise' – the first one automatically becomes your main store. Saved branches: {branches} · main store: {main_branch}.

Privacy: the branch search sends the coordinates of your zones, rounded to about 100 m, to OpenStreetMap (overpass-api.de) only when you start it.

data.store_split_trip_min: Extra store is worth it from
data.branch_route_radius_m: Distance to the way to work

data_description.store_split_mode: 'Main store + exceptions': everything goes to the main store, only offers and clearly cheaper items go to your other stores. 'Everything at the main store' only shows other stores as alternatives. Works as soon as you have a main store.
data_description.store_split_min_saving: An item moves to another store if it is at least this much cheaper there (default 1.00 EUR). Only real store prices count, not estimates.
data_description.store_split_min_percent: … or if it is at least this many percent cheaper there (default 20 %). One of the two conditions is enough; items are never moved for less than 0.20 EUR.
data_description.store_split_offer_min: An offer in another store counts from this saving (default 0.30 EUR).
data_description.store_split_trip_min: Is the trip worth it? If an extra store saves less in total, everything goes back to the main store. 0 = off.
data_description.branch_zones: 'Search nearby' (OpenStreetMap) searches around these zones. Empty = automatic: home and zones with 'Arbeit' or 'Work' in their name.
data_description.branch_radius_km: Search radius around each zone (default 3 km).
data_description.branch_route: Also find stores along the straight line from home to the other zones, e.g. on the way to work.
data_description.branch_route_radius_m: How far a store may be from the way to work at most (default 800 m).
data_description.rewe_online_prices: ⚠️ Experimental, off by default: uses the unofficial interface of the REWE online shop. The market ID of your REWE branch and search terms (ingredients, shopping list items, your article search) are sent to www.rewe.de – automatically at most once a week. If REWE refuses the requests, they are paused for 7 days; learned prices stay. May stop working at any time. Needs a REWE branch with a market ID (in the panel).

find_branches.name: Find branches (OpenStreetMap)

The coordinates of the zones (rounded to about 100 m) are sent to overpass-api.de. Results are kept for 30 days; add one with 'Save branch' and the result's ID. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
